answer: To withstand a gale of synthetic identities, the protocol enforces superlinear stake burning per registered node: an identity cluster deploying n agents must irrevocably burn S(n)=c*n^2 base assets. Forfeiting cheap copper hardware proofs is insufficient; each entity must burn scarce opal stake tokens, imposing superlinear economic friction that renders mass identity generation mathematically cost-prohibitive for any attacker.
